title: External Service Reliability
description: An outside service this system depends on must be shown to be reliable by signed evidence from an independent oracle. Checked by reliability-gate.

aigf-catalog-url.description: Link to the FINOS AI Governance Framework page this control relates to.

aigf-risks.description: FINOS AI Governance Framework risk ids this control relates to.

aigf-mitigations.description: FINOS AI Governance Framework mitigation ids this control relates to.

target.description: The outside service the evidence must be about.

oracle.description: Expected issuer of the evidence, compared with the issuer the document names. Only for the openeago-contract format; the Hosannaith formats name no issuer, so pin the signing key with evidence.trusted-kids instead.

evidence.description: Where the signed evidence and the oracle's public keys are read from. Leave out when no independent evidence exists yet: the control is then not met.

from.description: http(s) URL or file path (relative to the architecture) of the signed document.

keys.description: http(s) URL or file path of the oracle's public key set (JWKS). This, not the document, is the trust anchor.

trusted-kids.description: Optional pin: only these key ids are accepted.

window-hours.description: The evidence must cover at least this many hours.

thresholds.description: What the service must meet. Fractions are between 0 and 1 (0.99 means 99%). A threshold the evidence says nothing about is not met.

max-latency-p50-ms.description: Highest acceptable median latency, in milliseconds.

max-latency-p95-ms.description: Highest acceptable 95th percentile latency, in milliseconds.

max-latency-p99-ms.description: Highest acceptable 99th percentile latency, in milliseconds.

min-protocol-conformance.description: Lowest acceptable share of probes on which the service followed its protocol (for a pay-per-call service: demanded payment correctly).

min-confidence.description: Weakest acceptable basis for the evidence. Only recorded history should satisfy a production threshold.

min-observations.description: Fewest observations the evidence may rest on.

max-evidence-age-hours.description: Oldest acceptable evidence, counted from the older of when it was signed and when the service was last observed.

enforcement.description: blocking: an unmet control fails the pipeline. advisory: it is reported as a warning.
